Observability._comment_ServiceName: traceId/spanId/service/level are the mandatory fields on every log entry (observability-standards.md); ServiceName is the 'service' field. adminId/entityId are this service's own primary correlation fields (requirement-spec.md §3), pushed by AdminContextEnrichmentMiddleware.

Otlp._comment_Endpoint: OpenTelemetry Collector OTLP/gRPC endpoint. Services never ship traces/logs to Tempo/Loki directly (observability-standards.md).

GlobalConfig._comment_Path: Absolute path to a JSON file, outside the repo and never committed, holding this environment's actual ConnectionStrings/credential values (PLATFORM_BLUEPRINT.md Configuration Management). Program.cs layers it on top of this file at startup and fails fast if the path is unset or missing. Local dev sets the concrete path in appsettings.Local.json (see appsettings.Local.json.example); a deployed environment supplies it via the GlobalConfig__Path env var pointing at a mounted secret file.

ConnectionStrings._comment_AdminDatabase: Secret — supplied via the GlobalConfig file, never committed (PLATFORM_BLUEPRINT.md Configuration Management).

IdentityClientCredentials._comment_ClientId: Secret — this service's own service-principal client_id/client_secret for kart-identity-service's OAuth2 Client Credentials grant, supplied via the GlobalConfig file.

DownstreamServices._comment: Base URLs for the six owning services Admin proxies to (architecture.md Dependencies table). These placeholder host names are always overridden in every real deployment by the GlobalConfig file's per-service Services.kart-admin-service.DownstreamServices section (kart-devops/compose/globalconfig/global.json), which carries the actual docker-network-resolvable hostnames — see that file if a downstream call ever fails to resolve.
